overloads.semanticRole: The SET WINDOW TITLE command changes the title of the window whose reference number is passed in window to the text passed in title (max.

constraints: title is truncated to a maximum of 80 characters.
If the window reference number does not correspond to an existing window, SET WINDOW TITLE does nothing.

In the Design environment, 4D manages window titles automatically and is likely to override a title set by this command; in the Application (compiled/runtime) environment, 4D never changes window titles itself.
